ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Headbutt.cs:18-21) == cost 1 / ATTACK / COMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(9m, ValueProp.Move)` (Headbutt.cs:16) == `_damage = 9`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (Headbutt.cs:26-28), then select one card from the DISCARD pile (`CardSelectCmd.FromCombatPile(prefs: 1, pile: PileType.Discard.GetPile(Owner))`, 29) and move it to the TOP of the draw pile (`CardPileCmd.Add(cardModel, PileType.Draw, CardPilePosition.Top)`, 32). The sim's `draw_pile.append` is the top of its pile (end-of-list convention, stated in the code comment). The `predicate=lambda c: c is not self` (headbutt.py:45) is a CORRECT compensation, not a divergence: C# holds Headbutt in the Play pile so it is not among the discard-pile candidates, while the sim parks it in the discard-pile limbo (combat.py:452-454) and so must filter it out by hand. The sim's own docstring says so.  BLAST RADIUS, not re-verdicted per rule 3: `CardSelectCmd` auto-selects with no player choice and no RNG at or below MinSelect (CardSelectCmd.cs:287-290) where the sim's `select_cards` always delegates and otherwise falls back to `self._rng.sample` (combat.py:575-581) -- creature_card_cmds steps 104/105.

guards.what: an empty discard pile skips the move on both sides (Headbutt.cs:30 `if (cardModel != null)`)
guards.rationale: C#'s `FirstOrDefault()` yields null; the sim's `select_cards` returns `[]` for empty candidates (combat.py:575-576) and `if chosen:` skips. Same outcome.
